quests.title: Immersive Engineering
quests.desc:
&lIndustrial Foregoing&r has its sleak futuristic design, &5&lMekanism&r has its dull modern design, and &8&lImmersive Engineering&r takes it much more retro! 

Everything is &6Brown&r, &7Grey&r, and &8Dark Grey&r! 

The Mod all starts with the &6Engineer's Hammer&r. These can be used to make Plates, Dust, or just building our Multiblocks! 

BTW, did I tell you we'll be making a lot of those in this Mod? Hope you like them!

quests.title: Crude Blast Furnace
Steel Ingot
quests.desc:
I don't care how you got it, I just need you to get it! 

&8&lImmersive Engineering&r adds a whole lot more uses to &8Steel&r than just simple builds, almost everything will need &8Steel&r to make it! 

Tools, Mechanical Parts, and Building Blocks mainly. A lot are made with &8Steel Plates&r or &8Scaffolding&r. 

You'll need a lot of it but the &l&cCrude Blast Furnace&r and &l&6Alloy Kin&r can't be automated so we might need a...

quests.title: Improved Blast Furnace
Coke Oven
Creosote Oil
quests.desc:
&7Creosote Oil&r is a byproduct of the &lCoke Oven&r. 

Its main use will be for making Treated Wood, an essential Building Block of &8&lIE&r. 

You will also need it for a different Fluid later, we'll worry about it when we get there.

quests.title: Coke
quests.desc:
By Smelting &0Coal&r in a &lCoke Oven&r we can get &0Coal Coke&r! Or as I will call it, just &0Coke&r! 

It pretty much is just &0Coal&r but has more uses in &8&lIE&r. 

You can combine it with Iron to get &7Steel&r, Crush it to get &0Coke Dust&r which will be needed for &0Graphite&r, or use as Fuel for a Blast Furnace.

quests.title: Alloy Kiln
Constantan Ingot
quests.desc: &6Copper&r and &7Nickel&r will make &6Constantan&r! \nFinally this one is used quite a bit in &8&lIE&r, especially in Machines or Items using Heat and Metal, like Generators.

quests.title: Electrum Ingot
quests.desc: &eElectrum&r is an Alloy made from &eGold&r and &7Silver&r. \n\nYou can guess by its name it is used a ton in everything electricity related. Wires, Connectors, Transformers, ETC!

quests.title: Brass Ingot
quests.desc: A mix of &6Copper&r and &7Zinc&r. \n\nNot really used for much in &8&lIE&r... You can make Signs with it I guess...

quests.title: Invar Ingot
quests.desc: Invar Ingots are made with &7Iron&r and &7Nickel&r. \n\nLike a lot of these Alloys they aren't useful in &8&lIE&r.

quests.title: Bronze Ingot
quests.desc: This one is a combination of &6Copper&r and &7Tin&r! \n\nIt's used a ton in &7&lModern Industrialization&r! But in &8&lIE&r... not that much...

quests.title: Silo
Moving Items
quests.desc:
&eConveyor Belts&r are how we can move &eItems&r (and some Entities). 

When &eItems&r are dropped onto &eBelts&r they will hold them and move them. These can then be moved into different Inventories, if we want to extract from Inventories we'll need a special type of &eBelt&r! 

The way you place your &eBelt&r will determine where it moves, this can also be changed with the &6Engineer's Hammer&r! 
They need to be placed on Blocks but funny enough don't need Blocks below to keep standing and working!

quests.title: Tank
Moving Fluids
quests.desc:
Moving &bFluids&r is an essential part of &8&lIE&r, just think of the Creosote Oil and Plant Oil! 

&bFluid Pipes&r are our basic ways of moving &bFluids&r, if you want them faster check out &bFluid Pumps&r. 

&bFluid Pipes&r, like Energy Connectors, are determined where to &9Input&r and &6Output&r from what they are connected to. Some Machines need &4Redstone Signals&r to &6Output&r to &bFluid Pipes&r, like the &b&lTank&r! 

We can use an &6Engineer's Hammer&r to change what the &bPipes&r connect to, plus we can use &8Steel Scaffolding&r on them to cover them, or Dye to dye them!

quests.title: Storing Fluids
quests.desc:
Barrels are simple ways of holding &bFluids&r. 

There's Wooden Barrels and Metal Barrels. Wooden ones can only hold cold and room temperature &bFluids&r, not warm &bFluids&r or Gases. While Metal Barrels can hold all types of &bFluids&r and Gases. 

Both Barrels can hold 12 Buckets of &bFluid&r. They automatically &9Input&r from the Top side and &6Output&r to the Bottom but this can be changed.

quests.title: Storing Items
quests.desc:
Wooden Crates act as Barrels... but &2&lMinecraft&r ones, so Chests that can be opened from any side! 

They have 27 Slots but can be Shift Right Clicked with an &6Engineer's Hammer&r (multiple times) to shut them closed! This means they can be broken and preserve the &eItems&r inside. 

You can also edit the Text of the Crate to change its name as if it were in an Anvil. 

The Reinforced Crate works exactly the same as the normal one, just can't be blown up!

quests.title: Wire Coils
quests.desc:
Most Machines in &8&lIE&r will need &cEnergy&r to work, and &cWires&r are how we move it! 

&cWires&r are attached by Right Clicking one part with the &cWire Coil&r, then Right Clicking the second part with the same &cCoil&r. Their way can't be obstructed or else it won't connect. 

To pick up &cWires&r we can break what they are connected to, or use our trusty &6Wire Cutters&r! 

The different Tiers of &cWires&r effect how much they transfer, &5HV&r moving the most.

quests.title: Connectors
quests.desc:
&cConnectors&r are what... well connect! They connect &cWires&r from Machines, to &cAccumulators&r, to Generators, from pretty much everything! 

Whether a &cConnector &9Inputs &for &6Outputs&r is determined by the configuration of what it is attached to! 

They also have their own internal &cEnergy&r storage, the Tier of Voltage determines how much.

quests.title: Accumulators
quests.desc:
&cAccumulators&r are &8&lIE&r's version of batteries. 

They hold &cEnergy&r with &6LV&r holding 100kFE, &eMV&r holds 1MFE, and &5HV&r holds 4MFE! 

By default they have a top slot which only allows &9Input&r, but any side can be changed with the &6Engineer's Hammer&r to &9Input&r, &6Output&r, or Neither.

quests.title: Tiered Voltage
quests.desc:
Everything related to &cWires&r and &cpower&r in &8&lIE&r can be Tiered. &6Low Voltage&r (&6LV&r), &eMedium Voltage&r (&eMV&r), and &5High Voltage&r (&5HV&r). 

The higher the Voltage the more &cEnergy&r can be moved and used. Some Machines will need higher Voltage to be used. 

In order to transfer different Voltages you'll need &cTransformers&r, check out their Quest!

quests.title: Relays
quests.desc:
&cRelays&r don't connect &cWires&r to Machines, rather they connect &cWires&r to more &cWires&r! 

&cRelays&r work by combining a bunch of &cWires&r into one spot, so it will take all the &9Input &cEnergy&r and send them to &cConnectors&r to all the &6Outputs&r connected. 

This is helpful for when you have either one Power Generator that you want to charge multiple Machines!

quests.title: Pipe Valve
quests.desc:
&bPipe Valves&r work at helping sort and stop &bFluid&r flow! 

When used with &bFluid Pipes&r, they will make it so the &bFluid&r only goes in direction with the arrows on the &bPipe Valve&r. 

You can also send it a &4Redstone Signal&r to which it will completely stop &bFluid&r flow!

quests.title: Transformers
quests.desc:
&cTransformers&r are how we go from &6LV&r Connections to &eMV&r Connections. The little &cConnector&r is &6LV&r and bigger one is &eMV&r! 

If you want to go from &eMV&r to &5HV&r we'll need an &5HV Transformer&r. These work the same as the other &cTransformer&r, just the smaller &cConnector&r is &eMV&r and bigger one is &5HV&r! 

No, you can't go from &6LV&r to &5HV&r without &eMV&r!

quests.title: Light Engineering Block
quests.desc:
The &eLight Engineering Block&r is pretty easy recipe. 

You'll need 1 &6Copper Ingot&r, which I shouldn't have to explain it's literally a &2&lVanilla&r feature. 

4 &7Ironsheetmetal&r, which are just 4 &7Iron Plates&r combined with each other! 

You'll also need 4 &7Iron Mechanical Components&r, which are either 4 &7Iron Plates&r and a &6Copper Ingot&r in a Crafting Table, or 2 &7Iron Plates&r and a &6Copper Ingot&r in the &6Engineer's Workbench&r.

quests.title: Heavy Engineering Block
quests.desc:
Think of the &eLight Engineering Block&r, now just make all its components much harder to make! 

1st we need &eElectrum&r, which is an Alloy of &eGold&r and &7Silver&r made in the &6&lAlloy Kiln&r. 

2nd we need 4 &8Steel Sheetmetal&r, which like the &7Iron Sheetmetal&r, needs 4 &8Plates&r combined together. 

3rd is our &8Steel Mechanical Components&r which are either one &6Copper Ingot&r and 4 &8Steel Plates&r in a Crafting Table. or made cheaper in the &6Engineer's Workbench&r.

quests.title: Redstone Engineering Block
quests.desc: Easily the simplest of these Blocks to make. \n\nIron and &4Redstone&r you'll just get from &2&lVanilla&r gameplay, the only "difficult" Item is the &7Iron Sheetmetal&r.

quests.title: Generator Block
quests.desc:
You can check previous Quests to learn how to build some of these: &7Iron Mechanical Components&r in the &eLight Engineering Blocks&r and &8Steel Sheetmetal&r in &7Heavy Engineering Blocks&r. 
The &eElectrum Coils&r will be a bit different though... 

&eElectrum Coils&r need an Iron Ingot and 8 MV Wire Coils. To get MV Wire Coils we'll need to cut up some &eElectrum&r with Engineer's Wire Cutters.

quests.title: Radiator Block
quests.desc: For &8Radiators&r we'll need the usual &8Steel Sheetmetal&r, a &9Water Bucket&r which is a new one! And &6Constantan Plates&r. \n\n&6Constantan&r is an Alloy made by combining &6Copper&r and &7Nickel&r in an &l&6Alloy Kiln&r.

quests.title: Energy from moving things!
quests.desc:
The Kinetic Dynamo is a Generator which uses momentum to make Energy! 

To start making Energy you'll need either a Waterwheel or Windmill attached to the side with the giant gaping hole in it! 

The Kinetic Dynamo doesn't have an internal Energy storage, rather it provides Energy to connected Blocks like Connectors or Accumulators.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The Windmill is another option we can use with the Kinetic Dynamo! 

These will automatically start moving and with its speed we get Energy, so more speed more Energy. 

How do we get speed? Well for one, it needs space in front of it to work. The less blocks in front of it, the quicker it goes! 

Another factor into speed is Windmill Sails. You can add 8 Windmill Sails in total by Right Clicking the middle Windmill Block with the Sails in hand.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Water Wheels are one of the Machines we can use for the Kinetic Dynamo. 

These are much more compact but also expensive, compared to the Windmill. 

To use them you'll need &9Water&r flowing over the Waterwheel. The more &9Water&r around it, the faster it'll go. Just make sure the &9Water&r isn't flowing in 2 different ways! 

Being more compact means we can place 3 Waterwheels on 1 Kinetic Dynamo to get even more Energy.

quests.title: Energy from Temperature
quests.desc:
The Thermoelectric Generator, which I am going to just be calling a Thermo, is a unique Generator. 

On its own it won't do anything, what we'll need to do is place Blocks or Fluids of differenting Temperatures on different sides of the Thermo. 

The bigger the difference in Temperature the more Energy it creates!

quests.title: Treated Wood
quests.desc:
By combining 8 Planks of any Wood, with a &7Bucket of Creosote Oil&r, we'll get Treated Wood! 

Treated Wood is used in almost every single Item &8&lIE&r gives us, plus most of the simple Machines. 

Most important is the &6Engineer's Workbenches&r! These will give us a ton of new Recipes.

quests.title: Immersive Engineering Power!
quests.desc:
Lots of things need &cEnergy&r, especially in &8&lIE&r. To get started we'll need some &6Engineer's Wire Cutters&r! 

You can use those to snip some Plates into &cWires&r which can then be put into &cCoils&r, ready for use. 

They are also used for taking &cWires&r off &cConnectors&r.

quests.title: Cold Items
quests.desc:
&bBlue Ice&r- 200 K 
&bPacked Ice&r- 240 K 
&bIce&r- 260 K 
Snow- 273 K 
&9Water&r- 300

quests.title: Warm Items
quests.desc: &cMagma&r- 1300 K \n&cLava&r- 1300 K \n&aUranium&r- 2000 K

quests.title: Diesel Generator
Lightning Coil
Immersive Engineering Logistics
quests.desc: Like every Machine Mod, &8&lImmersive Engineering&r needs a way of moving &eItems&r, &bFluids&r, and more! \n\nMost Machines will have default set &6Outputs&r and &9Inputs&r but these can be configured, like with the &6Engineer's Screwdriver&r! You also might need to use an &6Engineer's Hammer&r but that's different.

quests.title: Metal Press
Crusher
Sawmill
Mixer
Bottling Machine
Fermenter
Squeezer
Refinery
Assembler
Automated Workbench
Arc Furnace
Excavator
Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Let's get these flames burning! 

The Preheater is a very simple addition to the &l&4Improved Blast Furnace&r. 

Simply place them on the Left and Right of the &l&4Improved Blast Furnace&r. Then, connect power to the top of it and it will start speeding up the &l&4Improved Blast Furnace&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: It's the same as the other Preheater I just wanted it to be symmetrical :D.

quests.title: Engineer's Workbench
quests.desc:
The &6Engineer's Workbench&r is a necessary Block needed for many Crafts and Upgrades. 

We can use it with &9Blueprints&r to Craft special Items that we can't Craft elsewhere. Put the &9Blueprints&r in the Left Slot, and our &eCrafting Items&r into the Right Slots.

Or we can throw our Tools into it, to add Upgrades to them, like the Revolver or Mining Drill! 

Also when you add &eItems&r and &9Blueprints&r you can see them on the &6Block&r itself, pretty cool!

quests.title: Engineer's Crafting Table
quests.desc:
Everybody loved the Crafting Stations from &lTinker's Construct&r and apparently so did the &8&lIE&r Devs! 

The &6Engineer's Crafting Table&r will act like a normal Crafting Table, with an added 18 Slots of Storage in it, plus it keeps your &eItems&r in the Grid when you stop viewing it! 

What more could you want!

quests.title: Revolver
quests.desc:
The most basic Gun we can find in &6&lATM10&r, the &d&lRevolver&r! 

Shift Right Click to open the &d&lRevolver&r, then move some Ammo into the Slots. After that, just Right Click to shoot! 

You can apply 2 Upgrades to it. The Upgrades being: Bayonet, Speedloader, Extended Magazine, Amplifier Electron Tubes, and Precision Scope. 

The &d&lRevolver&r can only hold 2 Upgrades but the Speedloader is technically different.

quests.title: Mining Drill
quests.desc:
The &4&lMining Drill&r does as the name suggests, it Mines! 

It works like a Pickaxe, just needing &8Drill Heads&r and &2Bio-Diesel&r. &8Drill Heads&r determine its Mining Level and have Durability which means they'll need to be replaced. You can attach &8Drill Heads&r in the &6Engineer's Workbench&r, in the Top Slot. 

&2Bio-Diesel&r is a &bLiquid Fuel&r which has a very difficult recipe to make... that's for a different Quest though we're just looking for how to Fuel it! You can use the &4&lDrill&r on any &bTank&r or Machine holding &2Bio-Diesel&r to fill it. 

The &4&lMining Drill&r will mine in a 3x3 or 2x2 area, unless you are Shifting while breaking! 

You can also Hit Mobs with it to do the same amount of Damage as a Netherite Sword, this takes up Fuel as well as Durability though. 

The &4&lMining Drill&r can hold 1 Drill Head and 3 Upgrades.

quests.title: Railgun
quests.desc:
Yes, it is just like the ones on giant Battleships! 

The &5&lRailgun&r is a special Gun. For 1. it uses special Ammo, not Cartridges like the Revolver uses 2. it uses &cEnergy&r and needs to charge before shooting. 

The Ammo it uses is &eItems&r from your Inventory: &7Aluminum&r, &7Iron&r, and &8Steel Rods&r, &0Graphite Electrodes&r, Sawblades, Enderpearls, Tridents, Blaze Rods, and End Rods. 

It'll take whatever is in your Inventory, to change what it Shoots, Hold Shift and Scroll. 

Next, it needs &cEnergy&r within it to Shoot, to charge it we can use any &cItem Charger&r, including the one added by &8&lImmersive Engineering&r! 

Once we have all this, Hold Right Click until the Railgun gets to Level 99, then release! 

The &5&lRailgun's&r Upgrades are: Precision Scope and Heatsinks. 

It can hold 2 Upgrades, well that makes sense it can't use anymore than that!

quests.title: Chemical Thrower
quests.desc: This one is supposed to shoot Chemicals like &bFluids&r or Gases... but it won't do it for me. \n\nIt can hold 2 Upgrades atleast! Those work!

quests.title: Fluid Pump
quests.desc:
&bFluid Pumps&r aren't just used for Bottlers, they can also be used to move &bFluids&r... quicker! 

Using an &6Engineer's Hammer&r we can set Sides of the &bFluid Pump&r to &9Inputs&r and &6Outputs&r. 

Then, we can Power it with &4Redstone&r or &cEnergy&r, with &cEnergy&r moving &bFluids&r much faster than &4Redstone&r.

quests.title: Fluid Router
quests.desc: &bFluid Routers&r sort and filter &bFluids&r passing through. \n\nYou'll need to set configs within its UI to set the Filters and which Side. Once you do that, it will take all &bFluids&r coming in and send them to where they are set to go!

quests.title: Fluid Outlet
quests.desc:
Now this is a fun one! 

&bFluid Outlets&r can be set to &9Input &bFluids&r, and then we can have it so it places those &bFluids&r as Source Blocks next to the &6Output&r Sides! 

This means we can automate placing of &9Water&r, &cLava&r, or pretty much any &bFluids&r!

quests.title: Chutes
quests.desc:
Chutes can take &eItems&r (and some Entities) and drop them without worry of despawning! 

They also drop &eItems&r pretty darn quickly. 

You can use the &6Engineer's Hammer&r to make a Chute curve to toss the &eItems&r onto a &eBelt&r!

quests.title: Types of Belts
quests.desc:
&eBelts&r come in all different shapes and sizes and uses! 

First, all &eConveyor Belts&r can be Crafted with &8Steel Scaffolding&r to give them covers. &eCovered Belts&r will make it so &eItems&r can't be picked up from Players while on it. 

The first and simplest version of the &eBelt&r is the &eVertical Belt&r. It simply takes &eItems&r upwards! 

&eSplitting Belts&r... split the directions the &eItems&r going in, go. It will switch for every &eItem&r: 1 goes Left, 1 goes Right, 1 goes Left, 1 goes Right. 

&eDropping Belts&r will drop the &eItems&r either into an Inventory below it, or if there is open space it will just drop the &eItems&r. These can be configured with &4Redstone&r to not drop &eItems&r. 

The last is the &eExtracting Belt&r, this one will automatically take &eItems&r out from Inventories and deploy it on its &eBelt&r. These can also be used with some Machines!

quests.title: Item Router
quests.desc: &eItem Router&r will &9Input &eItems&r and &6Output&r them to certain locations based on the Filtering set in its UI! \n\nThese can be set to &eBelts&r, Crates, or other Inventories.

quests.title: Item Batcher
quests.desc:
&eItem Batcher&r works kinda like the line for a Roller Coaster. 

The Roller Coaster won't leave until all seats are filled! The same way the &eBatcher&r won't &6Output&r &eItems&r until the set Filter and Amount has been matched. 

Perfect for stuff like &5&lMekanism&r Ore Processing which needs certain amounts of &eItems&r &9Inputed&r or else it will bottleneck.

quests.title: Arc Furnace Electrodes Blueprints
quests.desc:
These can't be Crafted, instead they are last Trades from a Machinist Villager. 

&0Graphite Electrodes&r are used as Fuel for the &8&lArc Furnace&r (also for Fluorescent Lights). 

To get them we'll need this special &9Blueprint&r.

quests.title: Banner Patterns Blueprints
quests.desc:
This &9Blueprint&r, like many others, can be Crafted. 

&8&lImmersive Engineering&r comes with it's own Banner Patterns! 

You'll need &9Blueprints&r to craft them though.

quests.title: Crafting Components Blueprints
quests.desc:
These can be Crafted. 

The &9Crafting Component Blueprint&r is one of the most important &9Blueprints&r. 

It is used to help the &6Engineer's Workbench&r make small Mechanical Components for cheaper than Crafting Tables. 

It also can be used for Crafting unique Items like Light Bulbs and Circuits!

quests.title: Warning Signs Blueprints
quests.desc: These &9Blueprints&r can be Crafted and boy are they cheap! \n\nWarning Signs are very simple decorations we can make with &7Metal Plates&r, Dyes, and this &9Blueprint&r.

quests.title: Specialized Projectiles Blueprints
quests.desc:
These can only be Traded with Gunsmiths for. 

Specialized Projectiles are ones that do unique things! 

Homing, Explosive, and Flares are needed to be Crafted with these &9Blueprints&r.

quests.title: Common Projectiles Blueprint
quests.desc: Can be Traded with a Gunsmith or Crafted. \n\nGuns aren't much fun without Bullets, so let's Craft some! In order to Craft them though we'll need this &9Blueprint&r.

quests.title: Metal Press Molds Blueprints
quests.desc:
&9Metal Press Mold Blueprints&r can be Crafted. 

&7&lMetal Press Multiblock&r will automate the creation of &7Metal Plates&r and &eItems&r. 

To press the &7Metals&r we'll need Molds. 

In order to make the Molds will need these &9Blueprints&r!

quests.title: Engineer's Skyhook
quests.desc:
The &6&lSkyhook&r works both as a Tool and Weapon. 

You can just smack Mobs with it as if it were a Sword or you can use it for moving around you base! 

When you get close to a &cWire&r (&6LV&r, &eMV&r, &5HV&r, Insulated, Hemp, &8Steel&r, &4Redstone&r) you can Hold Right Click to attach to them. Then, you can move around to slide down the &cWires&r! 

If you want to use it on active &cWires&r, you'll need some Upgrades! Upgrades like: High Torque Motor, Insulated Grip, and Heavy Impact Hooks. 

It can hold 2 Upgrades.

quests.title: Buzzsaw
quests.desc:
The &2&lBuzzsaw&r works similar to the &4&lMining Drill&r, just for &2Trees&r! 

It requires &2Bio-Diesel&r as Fuel, which I won't explain how to get here either! 

And some sort of &8Sawblade&r. Which you can attach via the Top Slot in the &6Engineer's Workbench&r. 

Simply break Logs on a &2Tree&r and every Log, Leaf, and Birds Nest will come down with it! You can hold Shift to not break everything attached. 

The &2&lBuzzsaw&r also does 10 Damage! Dang, why even use a Sword? Oh yeah &8Saws&r have Durability and it needs &2Bio-Diesel&r. 

The &2&lBuzzsaw&r can hold 1 &8Blade&r or &8Disk&r and 2 Upgrades.

quests.title: Heavy Plated Shield
quests.desc:
The &0&lHeavy Plated Shield&r is used just like a normal Shield, hold it in your Offhand and use it to defend yourself. 
The &0&lHeavy Plated Shield&r does have much more Durability and protects from more Damage. 

Oh yeah it also has Upgrades! These upgrades can be added on with the &6Engineer's Workbench&r. 

The Shield can hold 2 Upgrades.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: It's like Thorns but doesn't Damage, just disorients Attackers. \n\nIt'll just stop Mobs for a little, it is much more effective (and aggravating) to Players!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: With this Upgrade everyone who attacks you will 1. be Stunned which will stop them for a second 2. hurt them and 3. destroy any Projectiles. \n\nI think it's worth the Upgrade!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: It is supposed to Equip your &8&lHeavy Plated Shield&r when you Double Tap S... emphasis on supposed to. \n\nReminder that &8&lIE&r is in Beta still! Mod Development takes a lot of time and effort, be respectful of such!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Gotta go fast!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Live &cWires&r (&cWires&r transporting &cEnergy&r are Live &cWires&r) will hurt you when using a &6&lSkyhook&r on them. \n\nUnless you Insulate your Grip!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: These make the &6&lSkyhook&r act similar to a Mace, you'll do extra Damage hurting Mobs if you are falling while you hit them. \n\nIn Bioshock Infinite it's called a Skystrike!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The Precision Scope can be used on both the &5&lRailgun&r and the &d&lRevolver&r. \n\nWith the &d&lRevolver&r and &5&lRailgun&r you can press down Middle Click to use the Scope, then you can Scroll to adjust the magnification.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Advanced Heatsinks are our only &5&lRailgun&r exclusive Upgrades. \n\nIt will make it so the &5&lRailgun&r charges up much faster!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Now it shoots and smacks!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.sub: Did I shoot 6 times? Or only 5?
quests.desc: The Revolver Speedloader isn't actually an Upgrade, rather it is a seperate Item that's used to help. \n\nFill it with Cartridges like the &d&lRevolver&r, but now whenever you need to Reload the &d&lRevolver&r you can just Right Click with it to instantly reload!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: With this added on to your &d&lRevolver&r, your Bullets will give the Mobs you hit the Stunned Effect.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: This Upgrade gives space for 6 more Bullets! Making the total up to 14.

quests.title: Accumulator Backpack
quests.desc:
The &c&lAccumulator Backpack&r doesn't do much on your own, we'll need to give it an &cAccumulator&r in order to get some work out of it! Any &cAccumulator&r it's not judgy! 

Once you give it an &cAccumulator&r in an &6Engineer's Workbench&r, you can now charge it up. Once charged it will provide &cEnergy&r to Items in your Hand and Armor you are wearing. 

You can wear it on your Back Slot in Curios, your Chestplate Slot, or combine it with a Chestplate in a Crafting Table. 

The Backpack can hold 1 &cAccumulator&r and 3 Upgrades.

quests.title: Engineer's Toolbox
quests.desc:
The &e&lEngineer's Toolbox&r works as a segregated Shulker. 

It has sections: Food, which you can only put Food in. Tools, which can hold &8&lIE&r Tools or other Tools just not &bBuckets&r. &cWiring&r, which can have &cWires&r, &cConnectors&r, or &cRelays&r. And Anything, which doesn't discriminate. Try to be more like the Anything section! 

Some Items can't be held within it though, like &bBuckets full of Fluids&r or Accumulator Backpacks. 

You can Shift Right Click to place down the &e&lToolbox&r to make it act like a Chest, then you can do the same to pick it up.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: You can't wirelessly charge your &c&lAccumulator Backpack&r... but you can charge it &cwired&r! \n\nSimply attach your Charging Antenna to your &c&lAccumulator Backpack&r and walk up to any &cWires&r transporting &cEnergy&r and some of it will come to your &c&lBackpack&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &c&lBackpack&r by default will only charge &eItems&r in your Hand and Armor you are wearing. But what if we wanted to charge more than that! \n\nThen we'll need the Induction Charger! With this attached, every &eItem&r in your Inventory that can take charge, will charge.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: This one can attach to your &c&lAccumulator Backpack&r. \n\nWhen the &c&lBackpack&r is worn, &eItems&r nearby will be sucked into your Inventory!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The Miniture Telsa Coil will act like the Thorns Enchantment. \n\nAnyone who hits you, while you are wearing the &c&lBackpack&r, will be Shocked. Dealing Damage and giving an Effect!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The Advanced Lubrication System will act like Unbreaking to our &8Drill Heads&r and &8Buzzsaw Blades&r. \n\nThey will lose less Durability on use.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The Blade Quiver allows you to hold more &8Blades&r or &8Blade like Items&r on the &2&lBuzzsaw&r. 

To switch between the &8Blades&r (or &8Blade like Items&r) Hold Shift and Scroll. 

This is useful for replacing broken &8Blades&r or even switching to &8Grinding Disks&r!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The &4&lMining Drill&r, &2&lBuzzsaw&r, and &b&lChemical Thrower&r normally hold 1,000mB or 1 Bucket worth of &bFluid&r. 

Normally doesn't mean always! With the Large Tank they can now hold 2,000mB or 2 Buckets worth. 

It doesn't sound like a lot but trust me it is.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: In order to mine Blocks &bunderwater&r you'll need this Upgrade. \n\nIt also gives you Aqua Affinity! (That means being in &bWater&r doesn't slow down your Mining.)

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The Additional Augers are Sharpness... just for the &4&lDrill&r though! \n\nOh yeah and you can have 3 at a time, for stacked power.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &8&lIE&r Dev forgot the &4&lMining Drill&r can also be used for Mining so last minute he put in Fortune III. \n\nThat being the Rock Softening Acid.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: With this the &b&lChemical Thrower&r will be more of a Chemical Shooter. \n\nThe range will be increased but the spray width will be decreased. So it is more accurate!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Why just have 1 Tank, when we can use 3! 

You can now hold 3 different &bFluids&r in your &b&lChemical Thrower&r. Hold Shift and Scroll to switch between them. 

This can't be used with the Large Tank though...

quests.title: Drill Heads
quests.desc:
The &4&lMining Drill&r doesn't have many choices, we have an &7Iron Drill Head&r or a &8Steel Drill Head&r. 

&7Iron Drill Heads&r Mine in a 2x2 Area at the Tier of an &7Iron Pickaxe&r. It also does 6 Damage and has less Durability than the... 

&8Steel Drill Heads&r Mine in a 3x3 Area at the same Tier of a &bDiamond Pickaxe&r. These do 7 Damage and have more Durability!

quests.title: Ammo for Buzzsaw
quests.desc:
First, is the &8Sawblade&r. This is used for cutting down &2Trees&r. It will chop every Log and Leaf in the &2Tree&r above the Log that is cut. 

Second, is the &8Rockcutter Blade&r. This one can not break &2Trees&r, rather it is used as a Pickaxe with Silk Touch. It will break Stone and give you Stone instead of Cobble. 

Third is the &8Grinding Disk&r. It won't break &2Trees&r or Stone rather it'll break &7Metal Blocks&r! Good for &8Steel Scaffolding&r and scraping Oxidization off &6Copper&r!

quests.title: Safe for Skyhook usage!
quests.desc: Hemp Rope and &8Steel Cables&r are placed like normal &cWires&r on &cConnectors &fand &cRelays&r but won't transfer &cEnergy&r. \n\nInstead they are for Decor or using the &6&lEngineer's Skyhook&r!

quests.title: Railgun Ammo from IE
quests.desc:
&7Aluminum Rod&r - 10 
&7Iron Rod&r - 16 
&8Steel Rod&r - 24 
&8Sawblade&r - 12 
&0Graphite Electrode&r - 30

quests.title: Railgun Ammo from Minecraft
quests.desc:
&dEnd Rod&r does 10 Damage as well as hits Endermen. 
&5Enderpearls&r won't hit Mobs, rather they will teleport you much farther when shot. 
&3Trident&r acts like a normal &3Trident&r throw, dealing 8 Damage. 
&cBlaze Rods&r deal 10 Damage and set the Mobs on Fire!

quests.title: Common Projectiles
quests.desc:
Casull Cartridges are the default Bullets. They deal 5 Hearts of Damage, and that's it! 

Armor Piercing Cartridges will have a higher chance of ignoring Armor Points. This is perfect against Mobs like the Bulwark. 

Buckshot Shells will instead of shooting 1 Projectile, it will shoot multiple Projectiles. Use in close range for best effects! 

Silver Cartridges will act like Casull Cartridges but with higher Damage to the Undead Mobs: Zombies and Skeletons!

quests.title: Specialized Projectiles
quests.desc:
High Explosive Cartridges will shoot explosives at your Enemies, blowing up everything nearby like TNT would! 

Dragon's Breath Shells work like Buckshot, but now the Projectiles are on Fire!!!!! 

Phial Cartridges give Potion Effects based on the Potion used in its creation. 

Flare Shells work like Fireworks in a Crossbow. 

Homing Cartridges will aim after whatever Mob is closest to you... let's hope it's a dangerous Mob. 

Wolfpack Shells are like Buckshot Shells but now the Projectiles are Homing Cartridges!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The Telsa Coil is a very fun and &cEnergy&r hungry home defence! 

First, power it with &cEnergy&r from any of its Ports. Then, either give it a &4Redstone Signal&r to turn it on, or use a &6Engineer's Screwdriver&r to make it always on! 

Once it is on it will be actively using &cEnergy&r and when a Mob comes near it, it will Stun them and hurt them! Hurting Mobs makes it take more &cEnergy&r though. 

You can Shift Right Click with an &6Engineer's Screwdriver&r to set it to low power mode. It will take less &cEnery&r but also have less Range and deal less Damage!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The Chemthrower Turret has the same exact targeting as the Gun Turret so check there for more info! 

Just like the Gun Turret, the Chemthrower Turret needs &cEnergy&r from its ports. But it will also need &bFluids&r Piped in to hold and shoot. &9Input &bFluids&r with Pipes as you can't use &bBuckets&r to fill it, only &bPipes&r. 

The Chemthrower Turret has a storage of 4,000mB or 4 &bBuckets&r. You can also press a Button to Ignite &bFluids&r that are thrown. This will set Flammable &bFluids&r, on fire!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Gun Turrets will act as a &d&lRevolver&r with a Computer brain! 

They'll need &cEnergy&r from below it, and a &4Redstone Signal&r to turn on. Or use an &6Engineer's Screwdriver&r on it to make it always on. 

It uses the same Ammo as a &d&lRevolver&r, that includes Speciality Projectiles! You can &9Input&r Bullets into it and &6Output&r the Casings, or just have them dropped out with the Expel Casing Button. 

Before it starts shooting, we'll need to set its targeting. First, it won't attack the person who placed it. We also have a Type Bar we can add any Player or Mob name to Add in. These will make it so it spares them! 

It is automatically set to Blacklist, if it is Blacklisted that means it'll Shoot what is listed. We then have Animals which means Passive Mobs. Players means just Players. Neutral stands for any Neutral Mobs and Villagers. Don't worry it was always target Hostile Mobs!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Razor Wire works like Cobwebs... just sharper! 

The Razor Wire will Damage and Slow anything that tries to go through it, including us! 

We can safely take it apart with our &6Engineer's Wirecutters&r. 

Or we can use &6LV &cWires&r to make it do more Damage and a Stun Effect!

quests.title: Offense and Defense
quests.desc:
To start a war we need to first declare it! 

Just kidding, we just go straight to shooting! No diplomatic crap around here! 

To start, shoot a Pillager with a &d&lRevolver&r. 

This will start the spawning of new and harder Pillagers!

quests.title: Fusilier
quests.desc:
The Fusilier is the medium unit of the new Pillagers! 

They have 12 Hearts and no Armor. 

Their weapon of choice is a &5&lRailgun&r that is charged by their Accumulator Backpack they wear! 

On death they will drop &aEmeralds&r and &7Iron Rods&r.

quests.title: Commando
quests.desc:
Commandos are the light troops. 

They have 12 Hearts and no Armor. 

Their weapon is a &d&lRevolver&r and a Shield they hold in their Offhand. 

On death they will drop Revolver parts with different stats, similar to Apotheosis stats!

quests.title: Bulwark
quests.desc:
The Bulwark are the heavy units of these militants. 

They have 12 Hearts with 18 Armor Points! 

Their weapon is the &b&lChemthrower&r with a &8&lHeavy Plated Shield&r in the Offhand. 

If you somehow kill one you will get &aEmeralds&r and Masterwork Shader Bags!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The External Heater can be used with Furnaces, like the &2&lVanilla&r ones, not &c&lCrude Blast Furnace&r! 

It takes in &cEnergy&r from the Bottom and uses it for Heat. 

The Heat comes out of the other sides of it, to adjacent Blocks. 

It is technically used for the &4&lImproved Blast Furnace&r, by Crafting the Preheaters but I don't count that!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Our beloved Garden Cloche! It is an automatic Farm, and with this Quest is simple to use! 

To start it will need &cEnergy &6Input&r from either the Left, Right, or Top! 

It will then need &9Water&r from Back Port, (try using a &9Sink&r). 

Next, we'll need to Input our Seeds, Farmland, and optional Fertilizer by the &eItem &6Input&r at the Bottom! 

It will need the correct Farmland for the Seeds, you can check this all by Right Clicking the Cloche to see its GUI BTW! 

Once it has all that, it will quickly grow and harvest your Crops and &6Output&r them on the Front of the Dome. 

Last notes: it will keep the original Seed and Farmland and won't use them up, Dirt will be made into Farmland, and the Fertilizers are Sulfur, Slag, Nitrate, and Industrial Fertilizer.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
Turntable is pretty simple. The Top face with the &7Grey&r square will be the moving part. 

The other faces are the &4Redstone Ports&r, where you will give a &4Redstone Signal&r to activate it. 

When activated it will rotate whatever Block is attached to the Top. 

You might need to use your &6Engineer's Hammer&r on it to change how it rotates!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
A lot of things will need &cEnergy&r, including some &eItems&r that can't be placed down, like the &5&lRailgun&r! So how do we charge them? 

The Charging Station is our man for that job! 

Simply &6Input &cEnergy&r from either the Back or Bottom, and it will be ready to charge any &eItem&r put within it! 

This includes &5&lRailguns&r, &cAccumulators&r, and stuff from other Mods! It can't charge Blocks near it though...

quests.title: Small Machines
quests.desc: Some Machines in &8&lIE&r aren't Multiblocks, rather they are single-blocked! \n\nDon't think that, just because they are made with 1 Block that, they aren't important though!

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The Electromagnet is &8&lIE's&r take on the Absorption Hopper. 

Well, kinda! It won't hold the &eItems&r rather they will be moved closest to the Top face of the Electromagnet. 

This can be used to get them onto &eBelts&r or hoppers! 

It will require &cEnergy&r to be used though.

quests.title: AllRightsReserved
quests.desc:
Цей квест був створений &6командою AllTheMods&r або &2учасником спільноти&r для використання у збірках AllTheMods.

Оскільки всі збірки &6AllTheMods&r ліцензовані як &eВсі права захищено&r, цей квест не дозволяється використовувати у жодних публічних збірках, які не випущені командою &6AllTheMods Team&r без явного дозволу.

Цей квест навмисно прихований, якщо ви його бачите — ви перебуваєте в режимі редагування.
